spans.s: कु-चेल a. wearing bad or ragged clothes.
कु-चर्या f. wickedness, impropriety.

कुच् (I) vt. or vi. 6P (pp. कुचित) 1. To utter a shrill cry; 2. to go; 3. to polish; 4. to contract or be contracted; 5. to impede; 6. to write, to delineate.With सम्-, 1. to be crooked or curved; 2. to be contracted, मृगपतिरपि कोपात् संकुचत्युपतिष्णुः Panch.iii.; 3. to close, to fade, कमलवनानि समकुचन् D.K.

कुच् (II) vt. 1P (pp. कुंचित; pres. कुंचति) 1. To make crooked, to bend or curve; 2. to move or go crookedly; 3. to make small, to lessen; 4. to shrink, to contract.With आ-, to contract, to curve, to bend, K.S.iii.70, R.vi.15, Bhartr.i.3.With वि-, to contract, to curve, K.S.v.74.
कुच m. The female breast, a teat, a nipple, Am.
, Sr.

कुच-फल m. the pomegranate tree.
कुचर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. Going slowly, creeping; 2. low, vile; 3. detracting.
